title: Rieles, dinamita y calipso: La memoria obrera afroantillana
goal: Evaluate the Afro-Antillean contribution to Panamanian infrastructure, struggle against racial segregation, and musical legacy (calypso, reggae en español).
grammar: Identidad afroantillana y memoria obrera en Panamá

sections.title: Unit 8: Panama — Lesson 3
body: Welcome to lesson 3 of Unit 8 in the Latin American Regional Studies track: Panama: The Interoceanic Crossroads, Global Commerce & Afro-Antillean Identity.
In this lesson, we study rieles, dinamita y calipso: la memoria obrera afroantillana, evaluating Panama's physical geography, sovereignty struggles, cultural pluralism, and economic paradoxes.

items: Evaluate the Afro-Antillean contribution to Panamanian infrastructure, struggle against racial segregation, and musical legacy (calypso, reggae en español).
Master the lexicon and discourse of herencia-afroantillana-identidad-panamena.
Incorporate regional terminology (el bracero, la segregación).
